name: The Fool
description: The Fool represents new beginnings, having faith in the future, being inexperienced, not knowing what to expect, having beginner's luck, improvisation and believing in the universe.

name: The Magician
description: The Magician represents manifestation, resourcefulness, inspired action, and having the power to create the reality you desire.

name: The High Priestess
description: The High Priestess represents intuition, sacred knowledge, the divine feminine, and the subconscious mind.

name: The Empress
description: The Empress represents femininity, beauty, nature, nurturing, and abundance. She is a mother figure who brings comfort and growth.

name: The Emperor
description: The Emperor represents authority, structure, control, and father figure. He brings stability and order.

name: The Hierophant
description: The Hierophant represents spiritual wisdom, tradition, institutions, and conformity to social norms.

name: The Lovers
description: The Lovers represents love, harmony, relationships, and the alignment of values. It speaks to choices and commitments.

name: The Chariot
description: The Chariot represents control, willpower, success, action, and determination in achieving goals.

name: Strength
description: Strength represents inner strength, courage, persuasion, influence, and compassion. It's about gentle control.

name: The Hermit
description: The Hermit represents soul searching, introspection, being alone, and inner guidance through solitude.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description: The Wheel of Fortune represents good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny, and turning points.

name: Justice
description: Justice represents justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect, and the law of karma.

name: The Hanged Man
description: The Hanged Man represents pause, surrender, letting go, and gaining new perspectives through sacrifice.

name: Death
description: Death represents endings, change, transformation, and transition. It's about letting go of the old to make way for the new.

name: Temperance
description: Temperance represents balance, moderation, patience, purpose, and finding the middle way.

name: The Devil
description: The Devil represents shadow self, attachment, addiction, restriction, and materialism.

name: The Tower
description: The Tower represents sudden change, upheaval, chaos, revelation, and awakening.

name: The Star
description: The Star represents hope, faith, purpose, renewal, and spirituality. It brings healing and optimism.

name: The Moon
description: The Moon represents illusion, fear, anxiety, subconscious, and intuition. It speaks to what's hidden.

name: The Sun
description: The Sun represents positivity, fun, warmth, success, and vitality. It brings joy and abundance.

name: Judgement
description: Judgement represents judgement, rebirth, inner calling, and absolution. It's about reflection and transformation.

name: The World
description: The World represents completion, integration, accomplishment, and travel. It signifies the end of a cycle and fulfillment.
